name: Kiyonomiya Mitsu
source:
Mitsu is in 3rd year (one year older than Hitori) and is the president of the school’s festival committee, she was originally the vice president of the health committee but this year, she transferred to the festival committee. She appears to be the type who can handle anything but in reality, she’s really scared of things going wrong. She can also be a little selfish and has a childish side too. Mitsu has an old-fashioned view of love – that you must dedicate yourself to one person, due to this, she hates people talking about perverse things in front of her and gets angry and blushes madly when this happens. If she gets too emotional then she gets a nosebleed too!

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/06/12/preview-yomehapi-you-make-happy/]Liemyx's blog[/url]]
